newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian mass murderer Bryant not insane -.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian mass murderer Bryant not insane -.

text.p: Australian mass murderer Martin Bryant was not criminally insane when he gunned down 35 people at Port Arthur in April, but was suffering from a personality disorder, a court was told on Wednesday.
"There is no such (insanity) defence available to him," Prosecutor Damian Bugg told the Tasmanian Supreme Court, referring to the findings of a psychiatric report on Bryant.
Bryant last week confessed to murdering 35 people at the Port Arthur historic convict site on the island state of Tasmania on April 28.
But Bryant's lawyer John Avery on Wednesday told the court said his client would give no explanation for his killing spree.

"I am instructed to make no submissions or place before the court any explanation or reason for this massacre, other than can be gleaned from the medical material," Avery told a sentencing hearing. A psychiatric report on Bryant said he suffered from a mental disorder, but was not insane.
The prosecution has said Bryant planned the massacre for months and has asked the judge to jail him for life, without parole.
